description: 💅🏻 ⚒ A collection of awesome design systems
readmeExcerpt:
Know a resource that isn't listed below? Feel free to create a new [pull request](https://github.com/alexpate/awesome-design-systems/pulls).

> A design system is a collection of documentation on principles and best practices, that helps guide a team to build digital products. They are often embodied in UI libraries and pattern libraries, but can extend to include guides on other areas such as 'Voice and Tone'.

---

### Tags

- Components: Contains coded patterns and examples.
- Voice & Tone: Provides guidance on how language should be used.
- Designers Kit: Includes a Sketch/Photoshop/Figma/etc. file for designers.
- Source code: Publicly viewable source code

aiSummary.oneLiner: A meticulously curated, comprehensive collection of top-tier design systems, component libraries, and UI guidelines.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides a highly organized and comprehensive index of exemplary design systems from major organizations worldwide. It functions as a centralized directory for developers, designers, and product managers to discover and analyze how industry leaders structure their visual language and component libraries. The collection categorizes systems based on their underlying technologies and available resources, providing direct links to source code, documentation, and live examples. By compiling these resources, it serves as an invaluable reference tool for teams establishing or refining their own design standards.
keyFeatures: Extensive System Directory: Catalogs a massive variety of established design systems from well-known global tech companies and governments.
Technology Breakdown: Clearly identifies which design systems provide React, Vue, Web Components, or raw CSS implementations.
Direct Resource Links: Provides immediate access to official documentation, source code repositories, and interactive component playgrounds.
Open Source Focus: Highlights design systems that are publicly accessible and often open source, facilitating easy code review and adaptation.
Community Driven Updates: Continuously refined and expanded by contributions from the broader design and development community.

useCases.title: Design System Research
useCases.description: Product teams exploring the repository to understand how leading companies document and structure their UI components and design tokens.

useCases.title: Component Architecture Benchmarking
useCases.description: Frontend engineers reviewing the source code of established systems to learn best practices for building scalable React component libraries.

useCases.title: UI Inspiration
useCases.description: Designers browsing various style guides to gather inspiration for typography, color palettes, and interactive component states.

useCases.title: Framework Selection
useCases.description: Developers using the list to quickly find robust, open-source component libraries that support their specific frontend tech stack.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: UX/UI designers, frontend engineers, and product managers who are researching, building, or maintaining a design system and need references from industry leaders.
